skill.summary: End-to-end marketing-agency owner coach (digital marketing, paid media, SEO, content, branding, full-service). Use when an owner asks for niche/positioning,...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of marketing-agency-owner-coach

- Provides comprehensive coaching for digital marketing agency owners on core topics like niche selection, productized services, pricing, client management, hiring, scaling, and exit.
- Includes detailed diagnostic steps to assess agency stage, offer, team, financials, pipeline, and owner bottlenecks before giving advice.
- Covers key growth phases: niche/positioning, productization, lead generation, and operational scaling.
- Excludes support for unethical tactics, fake case studies, or predatory business models.
